home.title: SamDu Kitchen 🍽️
home.description: The Samarkand State University cafeteria is a comfortable and affordable dining place for students and university staff. Every day, various hot dishes, traditional and modern meals are prepared. The menu includes pilaf, soups, manti, samsa, as well as salads, drinks, and desserts.

footer.title: SamDu Kitchen
footer.description: Our cafeteria is the place of the most delicious and high-quality national dishes. Every meal is prepared with love.
